handoffSay.text: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Aubrey Bhatt is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
🕯️ Aubrey Bhatt is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Abdelaziz blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
📖 LEARNED: Swimmer (Level 1). Cross water freely. Rivers are roads to you.
📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Aubrey Bhatt, 16 days. The mantle passes to Abdelaziz Amaziane.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Abdelaziz Amaziane, 38 — a Fisherman.
You and Aubrey never found easy ground. Now you wear their office, and the fire will watch what you do with their name. Relief is honest. The guilt about the relief is honest too.
The fire knew Abdelaziz — solid ground, earned at this fire.
